purpose: Document first-party local registry/viewer evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official Taizhou bureau documents and municipal spatial-data portal were reviewed. Portal access did not reveal a public cadastral feature service, and the Zhejiang public-map host returned HTTP 420 during the read-only request. A superficially similar Jiangsu Taizhou (泰州) portal was excluded because the ranked point is Taizhou, Zhejiang (台州). No geometry request was made. Whether the official TianDiTu Taizhou or spatial-data platform exposes parcel polygons to anonymous clients, and whether that service covers the WUP point.
